definitions.text_en: one (1); a single unit or individual
definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' unità waħda jew ma' individwu wieħed, 1.

usage_examples.mt: Hemm student wieħed biss fil-klassi dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: There is only one student in the class this morning.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' żewġ unitajiet, 2.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi tnejn minn dawk il-kotba fuq l-ixkaffa.
usage_examples.en: I have two of those books on the shelf.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' tliet unitajiet, 3.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm tlieta min-nies jistennew quddiem il-bieb.
usage_examples.en: There were three people waiting in front of the door.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral tlieta is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form tliet serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali tlieta huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra tliet tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' erba' unitajiet, 4.

usage_examples.mt: Xtara erbgħa minnhom biex iqassamhom lil sħabu.
usage_examples.en: He bought four of them to distribute to his friends.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral erbgħa is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form erba' serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali erbgħa huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra erba' tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tagħha. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' ħames unitajiet, 5.

usage_examples.mt: Fadal ħamsa minnhom biss fil-kaxxa.
usage_examples.en: Only five of them remain in the box.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral ħamsa is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form ħames serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali ħamsa huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra ħames tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' sitt unitajiet, 6.

usage_examples.mt: It-tfal kollha kienu sitta b'kollox fil-grupp.
usage_examples.en: The children were six in all in the group.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral sitta is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form sitt serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali sitta huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra sitt tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tagħha. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' tmien unitajiet, 8.

usage_examples.mt: Waslu tmienja minnhom fil-ħin għal-laqgħa.
usage_examples.en: Eight of them arrived on time for the meeting.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral tmienja is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form tmien serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.

Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' żewġ għaxriet, 20.

usage_examples.mt: Għalaq għoxrin sena nhar il-Ħadd li għadda.
usage_examples.en: He turned twenty years old last Sunday.

etymology_notes.text_en: Mitt is the t marbuta (tied t) form of mija.
etymology_notes.text_mt: Mitt hija l-forma bit-t marbuta ta' mija.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li jikkorrispondi għal mitt unità, 100.

usage_notes.en: Used before the noun it quantifies, as in "mitt sena" (a hundred years).
usage_notes.mt: Tintuża qabel in-nom li tikkwantifika, bħal f'"mitt sena".

usage_examples.mt: Għex aktar minn mitt sena b'saħħa tajba.
usage_examples.en: He lived more than a hundred years in good health.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li jikkorrispondi għal elf unità, 1,000.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kuntratt jiswa aktar minn elf ewro.
usage_examples.en: The contract is worth more than a thousand euros.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li jikkorrispondi għal elf elf unità, 1,000,000.

usage_examples.mt: Inġabru aktar minn miljun ewro b'risq dawk fil-bżonn.
usage_examples.en: More than a million euros were collected for those in need.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni li tibda ordni jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Kien l-ewwel student li wasal fl-iskola dalgħodu.
usage_examples.en: He was the first student who arrived at school this morning.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara l-ewwel f'ordni jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Fit-tieni kapitlu tal-ktieb jiddiskuti t-tibdil fil-klima.
usage_examples.en: In the second chapter of the book he discusses climate change.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara t-tieni f'ordni jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Daħal fit-tielet post fil-kompetizzjoni nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: He finished in third place in the national competition.

definitions.text_en: half; one of two equal parts (½, 0.5, or 50%)
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn żewġ partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.
Il-punt jew il-mument ċentrali ta' medda ta' spazju jew żmien.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa nofs il-ħobża u ħalla l-kumplament għal għada.
usage_examples.en: He took half of the loaf of bread and left the rest for tomorrow.

etymology_chain.definition: pair (two things, persons or animals considered as pair); yoke (two animals joined together)

definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva ta' tnejn li tindika żewġ elementi.

usage_notes.en: Żewġ is used directly before a noun; the extended form żewġt also occurs before certain nouns.
usage_notes.mt: Żewġ tintuża direttament qabel nom; il-forma twila żewġt tidher ukoll quddiem ċerti nomi.

usage_examples.mt: Qiegħed żewġ kotba fuq il-mejda biex jaqrahom aktar tard.
usage_examples.en: He placed two books on the table to read them later.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont darbtejn daqs il-kwantità oriġinali, jew magħmul minn żewġ partijiet indaqs.

usage_examples.mt: Ħallas prezz doppju minħabba d-domanda kbira li kien hemm.
usage_examples.en: He paid double the price due to the high demand there was.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont jew ħaġa li ġiet irduppjata jew magħmula darbtejn.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa sehem bi sforz mtenna biex jirbaħ il-kompetizzjoni.
usage_examples.en: He took part with a redoubled effort to win the competition.

definitions.text_en: third; one of three equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn tliet partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Terz mill-popolazzjoni attendiet għaċ-ċelebrazzjoni nazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: A third of the population attended the national celebration.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont tliet darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali, jew magħmul minn tliet partijiet.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa sehem f'investiment li ġablu qligħ triplu fl-aħħar tas-sena.
usage_examples.en: He took part in an investment that brought him triple profit at the end of the year.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont li ġie mmultiplikat bi tlieta jew magħmul minn tliet partijiet.

usage_examples.mt: L-art kellha qsim mtellet f'diversi biċċiet indaqs.
usage_examples.en: The land had a threefold division into several equal pieces.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara t-tielet f'ordni jew sekwenza.

usage_examples.mt: Kien ir-raba' wieħed li daħal fil-kamra tal-laqgħat.
usage_examples.en: He was the fourth one who entered the meeting room.

definitions.text_en: quarter; one of four equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn erba' partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

definitions.text_en: quarter of an hour; fifteen minutes
definitions.text_mt: Medda ta' ħmistax-il minuta.

usage_examples.mt: Għadda kwart ta' siegħa minn meta telaq il-vapur.
usage_examples.en: A quarter of an hour has passed since the ship departed.

definitions.text_en: quarter; one of four equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn erba' partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.
Waħda minn erba' partijiet ta' laħam.

usage_examples.mt: Ħalla robu' mill-qamħ merfugħ fil-maħżen għaż-żerriegħa.
usage_examples.en: He left a quarter of the grain stored in the warehouse for seed.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont erba' darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: Irreġistraw produzzjoni kwadrupla meta mqabbla mas-sena ta' qabel.
usage_examples.en: They recorded quadruple production compared to the previous year.

definitions.text_en: squared, fourfold; multiplied by four or having four equal sides or parts
definitions.text_mt: Numru multiplikatur li jindika ammont immultiplikat b'erba' jew għamla b'erba' naħat indaqs.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kamra kienet ta' daqs mrabba' perfettament.
usage_examples.en: The room was of perfectly squared dimensions.

definitions.text_en: four at a time; in groups of four; in fours
definitions.text_mt: Għadd jew tqassim f'gruppi ta' erbgħa kull darba.

usage_examples.mt: Qassmu t-tuffieħ rbiegħ lit-tfal fil-klassi.
usage_examples.en: They distributed the apples four each to the children in class.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara r-raba' f'ordni jew sekwenza.
Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' ħames unitajiet, 5.

usage_examples.mt: Kien il-ħames parteċipant li lesta t-tellieqa sal-aħħar.
usage_examples.en: He was the fifth participant who completed the race to the end.

definitions.text_en: fifth; one of five equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn ħames partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Ħallas biss kwint mill-ammont totali tad-dejn.
usage_examples.en: He paid only a fifth of the total amount of the debt.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont ħames darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-produzzjoni kienet kwintupla meta mqabbla mas-sena l-oħra.
usage_examples.en: The production was fivefold compared to last year.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara l-ħames f'ordni jew sekwenza.
Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' sitt unitajiet, 6.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kapitlu sitt jispjega l-iżvilupp ewlieni tal-ġrajja.
usage_examples.en: Chapter six explains the main development of the event.

definitions.text_en: sixth; one of six equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn sitt partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa sest biss mill-art li kienet tmiss lilu b'wirt.
usage_examples.en: He took only a sixth of the land that belonged to him by inheritance.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont sitt darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: In-nefqa kienet sestupla meta mqabbla mal-istima oriġinali.
usage_examples.en: The expense was sixfold when compared to the original estimate.

definitions.text_en: six at a time; in groups of six
definitions.text_mt: Għadd jew tqassim fi gruppi ta' sitta kull darba.

usage_examples.mt: L-artisti daħlu stiet fuq il-palk quddiem l-udjenza.
usage_examples.en: The performers entered six each onto the stage in front of the audience.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara s-seba' f'ordni jew sekwenza.
Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' tmien unitajiet, 8.

usage_examples.mt: Fit-tmien jum tal-vjaġġ waslu fl-aħħar port.
usage_examples.en: On the eighth day of the voyage they arrived at the final port.

definitions.text_en: eighth; one of eight equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn tmien partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Biegħ tomon żejt skont il-kejl antik tas-suq.
usage_examples.en: He sold an eighth of oil according to the ancient market measure.

definitions.text_en: eighth; one of eight equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn tmien partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: L-art kienet imqassma f'ottavi ndaqs bejn l-aħwa.
usage_examples.en: The land was divided into equal eighths between the siblings.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont tmien darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: Ksibna riżultat ottuplu grazzi għall-effiċjenza tat-teknoloġija ġdida.
usage_examples.en: We achieved an eightfold result thanks to the efficiency of the new technology.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' seba' unitajiet, 7.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm sebgħa min-nies bilqiegħda madwar il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: There were seven people sitting around the table.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral sebgħa is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form seba' serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali sebgħa huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra seba' tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara s-sitt f'ordni jew sekwenza.
Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' seba' unitajiet, 7.

usage_examples.mt: Kien is-seba' wieħed li wasal fil-quċċata tal-għolja.
usage_examples.en: He was the seventh one who arrived at the top of the hill.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna seba' ijiem biex inlestu x-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: We have seven days to finish the work.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' disa' unitajiet, 9.

usage_examples.mt: Il-grupp kien magħmul minn disgħa b'kollox.
usage_examples.en: The group was made up of nine in total.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral disgħa is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form disa' serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali disgħa huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra disa' tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara t-tmien f'ordni jew sekwenza.
Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' disa' unitajiet, 9.

usage_examples.mt: Kien id-disa' xahar tas-sena meta seħħet il-bidla.
usage_examples.en: It was the ninth month of the year when the change occurred.

usage_examples.mt: Ixtara disa' kotba ġodda għal-librerija.
usage_examples.en: He bought nine new books for the library.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' għaxar unitajiet, 10.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm għaxra min-nies jistennew fil-kju.
usage_examples.en: There were ten people waiting in the queue.

usage_notes.en: Grammatically, the cardinal numeral għaxra is feminine in morphological form (bearing the feminine suffix -a), with the short attributive form għaxar serving as its masculine counterpart. In syntactic usage and as an abstract counting number, however, it functions as a common-gender word.
usage_notes.mt: Grammatikalment, in-numru kardinali għaxra huwa ta' forma femminili (bil-morfema femminili -a), filwaqt li l-għamla attributtiva mqassra għaxar tiffunzjona bħala l-kontroparti maskili tiegħu. Madankollu, fl-użu sintattiku u bħala numru astratt fl-għadd, jaġixxi bħala kelma ta' ġeneru komuni.

definitions.text_mt: Pożizzjoni immedjatament wara d-disa' f'ordni jew sekwenza.
Kwantità li tikkorrispondi ma' għaxar unitajiet, 10.

usage_examples.mt: Wasal fl-għaxar post fost il-kompetituri kollha.
usage_examples.en: He arrived in tenth place among all the competitors.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna għaxar minuti biex nilħqu tal-linja.
usage_examples.en: We have ten minutes to catch the bus.

definitions.text_en: seventh; one of seven equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn seba' partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa wiret biss is-settimu tal-wirt kollu.
usage_examples.en: He inherited only a seventh of the entire estate.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont seba' darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-profitti żdiedu b'mod settuplu f'dawn l-aħħar snin.
usage_examples.en: Profits increased sevenfold in recent years.

definitions.text_en: ninth; one of nine equal parts
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn disa' partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa.

usage_examples.mt: Ħa biss nonu mis-somma li kienet dovuta.
usage_examples.en: He took only a ninth of the sum that was due.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont disa' darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm qabża nonupla fl-għadd ta' viżitaturi din is-sena.
usage_examples.en: There was a ninefold leap in the number of visitors this year.

definitions.text_en: tenth; one of ten equal parts (tithe)
definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn għaxar partijiet indaqs li flimkien jagħmlu ħaġa sħiħa; l-għexur.

usage_examples.mt: Kien jagħti d-deċmu mid-dħul tiegħu għall-karità.
usage_examples.en: He used to give a tenth of his income to charity.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont għaxar darbiet daqs il-kwantità oriġinali.

usage_examples.mt: Irċieva kumpens deċuplu għat-telf li ġarrab.
usage_examples.en: He received tenfold compensation for the loss he suffered.

definitions.text_en: three; short attributive form used before nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva qasira ta' tlieta li tintuża direttament qabel nom.

usage_notes.en: Tliet is used before consonant-initial plural nouns (e.g. tliet kotba); the long attributive form tlitt is used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns (e.g. tlitt itfal).
usage_notes.mt: Tliet tintuża qabel nomi plurali li jibdew b’konsonanti (eż. tliet kotba); il-forma twila tlitt tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b’vokali jew i-protetika (eż. tlitt itfal).

usage_examples.mt: Dam tliet ijiem jistrieħ id-dar wara l-vjaġġ twil.
usage_examples.en: He spent three days resting at home after the long trip.

definitions.text_en: four; short attributive form used before nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva qasira ta' erbgħa li tintuża direttament qabel nom.

usage_notes.en: Erba' is used before consonant-initial plural nouns (e.g. erba' kaxxi); the long attributive form erbat is used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns (e.g. erbat itfal).
usage_notes.mt: Erba' tintuża qabel nomi plurali li jibdew b’konsonanti (eż. erba' kaxxi); il-forma twila erbat tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b’vokali jew i-protetika (eż. erbat itfal).

usage_examples.mt: Għaddew erba' snin minn mindu mar joqgħod barra.
usage_examples.en: Four years have passed since he went to live abroad.

definitions.text_mt: Waħda minn erba' partijiet ta' laħam.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelma li tintuża meta Tal-Laħam ineħħi l-għadam minn xi parti tar-robbu hi TISPOLPJA.
usage_examples.en: The word used when the butcher removes the bone from a part of the quarter of meat is 'tispolpja'.

definitions.text_en: two; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' tnejn li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Għandhom żewġt itfal li jmorru fl-istess skola.
usage_examples.en: They have two children who go to the same school.

definitions.text_en: three; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' tlieta li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Stenna tlitt ijiem qabel ma rċieva t-tweġiba uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: He waited three days before receiving the official reply.

definitions.text_en: four; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' erbgħa li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Erbat irġiel għenu biex iġorru l-għamara tqila.
usage_examples.en: Four men helped carry the heavy furniture.

definitions.text_en: five; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' ħamsa li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Għamel ħamest ijiem jaħdem fuq il-proġett il-ġdid.
usage_examples.en: He spent five days working on the new project.

definitions.text_en: seven; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' sebgħa li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġimgħa għandha sebat ijiem.
usage_examples.en: The week has seven days.

definitions.text_en: eight; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' tmienja li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Baqgħu Għawdex għal tmint ijiem fis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: They stayed in Gozo for eight days in the summer.

definitions.text_en: nine; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' disgħa li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Disat itfal ħadu sehem fil-kompetizzjoni tal-ġiri.
usage_examples.en: Nine children took part in the running competition.

definitions.text_en: ten; long attributive form used before vowel-initial or i-prothetic nouns
definitions.text_mt: Forma attributtiva twila ta' għaxra li tintuża qabel nomi li jibdew b'vokali jew i-protetika.

usage_examples.mt: Għaddew għaxart ijiem minn meta bgħatna l-ittra.
usage_examples.en: Ten days have passed since we sent the letter.

definitions.text_mt: Għadd li jikkorrispondi għal mitt unità, 100.

usage_notes.en: Mija is the independent cardinal form used when counting or standing alone; before a noun, mitt is used (e.g. mitt sena). Dual: mitejn (200); plural: mijiet (hundreds).
usage_notes.mt: Mija hija l-forma kardinali indipendenti meta tgħodd jew meta tkun waħedha; qabel nom tintuża mitt (eż. mitt sena). Dual: mitejn (200); plural: mijiet.

usage_examples.mt: Għodd sa mija qabel ma tibda tfittex.
usage_examples.en: Count to a hundred before you start looking.
